interpretations: For transactions with `trans.amount >= 2400`, average signed amounts per account using only `PRIJEM` and `VYDAJ`, and average balances per account using all qualifying transactions; then average each figure across accounts separately.

For transactions with `trans.amount > 2400`, average signed amounts per account using only `PRIJEM` and `VYDAJ`, and average balances per account using all qualifying transactions; then average each figure across accounts separately.
For transactions with `trans.amount >= 2400`, exclude other or missing transaction types from both per-account averages; then average each figure across accounts separately.
For transactions with `trans.amount > 2400`, exclude other or missing transaction types from both per-account averages; then average each figure across accounts separately.
queries:
WITH per_account AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        AVG(CASE
            WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount
            WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount
        END) AS avg_signed_amount,
        AVG(balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE amount >= 2400
    GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT
    AVG(avg_signed_amount) AS avg_signed_amount,
    AVG(avg_balance) AS avg_balance
FROM per_account

WITH per_account AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        AVG(CASE
            WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount
            WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount
        END) AS avg_signed_amount,
        AVG(balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE amount > 2400
    GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT
    AVG(avg_signed_amount) AS avg_signed_amount,
    AVG(avg_balance) AS avg_balance
FROM per_account

WITH per_account AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount END) AS avg_credit,
        AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount END) AS avg_withdrawal
    FROM trans
    WHERE amount >= 2400
      AND type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')
    GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT
    AVG(avg_credit) AS avg_credit_across_accounts,
    AVG(avg_withdrawal) AS avg_withdrawal_across_accounts
FROM per_account

WITH account_averages AS (
    SELECT account_id, type, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM trans
    WHERE amount > 2400
      AND type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')
    GROUP BY account_id, type
)
SELECT
    AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN avg_amount END) AS avg_credit,
    AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN avg_amount END) AS avg_withdrawal
FROM account_averages
